title: Introduction to Infant and Toddler Teaching
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

outcomes: Apply general knowledge of development in the physical, cognitive, and psychosocial domains from conception through age three, including knowledge about typical and atypical development.
Discuss and apply skills needed in intentional teaching consistent with developmentally appropriate practices for infants and toddlers.

Complete assignments satisfactorily that require beginning principles of curriculum planning and environmental design that are consistent with current best practices and components of the California Early Learning system for Infants-Toddlers.
Apply professional and ethical standards of behavior in the college classroom or workplace with children, families, colleagues, and coworkers.
